steps.instruction: Slice the potatoes into small or large wedges.
Heat 1/2 quart of vegetable oil in a pan to 350 °F.
Fry the potatoes in the oil until light brown.
Season the potatoes with salt to taste.
Fry 2 1/2 pounds of small chicken pieces for 5 minutes.
Drain the oil or move the chicken to a different pan.
Add 3/4 cup of water and simmer the chicken for 15 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 3/4 cup of water and simmer the chicken for 15 to 20 minutes. Wash your hands after handling the raw chicken.

steps.instruction: Put the chicken and potatoes together, with the potatoes on top.
Add cumin to taste and simmer for about 20 minutes.
